record_bodies_after.courier-relay/protocol-1-acceptance-cont: Courier Relay / protocol-1 acceptance contract (vendor/protocol-1.md): delivery_id alone identifies a delivery across ALL accounts — the same delivery_id under a different account_id is still the same delivery identity, not a separate one. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery_id: the one with the earliest occurred_at UTC instant; ties broken by smallest record_id (Unicode code-point order). All other receipts sharing that delivery_id are duplicates. Accepted receipts keep their original fields/timestamp spelling/payload and are reported in original input order where an ordered list is needed. Because acceptance is scoped to delivery_id only (never account_id), the single-account "count" command and the cross-account "summary" command use the identical acceptance/dedup algorithm (main.py:count_receipts) — summary just calls the same function; both return {protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count}. account_id is carried on receipts but does not affect acceptance under protocol 1.
